title: Establish evidence-backed runtime implementation ledger
goal: Create a non-product source of implementation evidence that can mark a capability implemented only when verified work, handoff and runtime-boundary evidence all agree.
inputs: verified E9 bounded pilot implementation evidence
invariants: Product Spec Delivery Roadmap Phase 7 is not created or implied
implementation readiness is evidence-backed and never inferred from documentary PASS alone
security_properties: no new product-runtime dependency is introduced by program compilation
verified implementation claims require exact runtime/work evidence
blocked dependency or decision states cannot be silently upgraded to READY

performance_budget.rationale: program compilation runs on every relevant planning change and must remain cheap relative to product validation
metrics: control-plane compilation remains deterministic and bounded by repository metadata size

rollback.strategy: revert E10 program metadata while retaining the VERIFIED E0-E9 foundation

definition_of_done: ledger schema and audit are machine-readable and fail closed
CAP-SET-004 is represented only from verified E9 runtime evidence
duplicate, unowned, non-VERIFIED or missing-boundary claims fail
ledger records evidence references rather than redefining Product Spec semantics
